caption: The drawing depicts a single large stoneware crock, rendered in shades of light brown and muted tan, with darker shading for depth and contour. The crock has a cylindrical shape with a wide, slightly flared rim at the top, and two small, ear-shaped handles on either side close to the rim. Near the top, there is blue-gray text that reads: “H. A. MACQUOID NEW YORK LITTLE W 12th ST. 2.” Below the text, there are two stylized blue floral designs, consisting of sweeping lines and petal shapes, painted on the front surface of the crock. The background is a plain, off-white color with subtle shading near the edges, and a faint rectangular border outlines the drawing itself. The artist’s signature, “Gertrude Lemberg,” appears at the bottom right corner of the inner border.
title: Jar
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
